Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 20 Jun 2002 00:07:22 +0200, "Orpheus" asked:

>Can Krassimir redo the same action, even under NRA, given that the

> first action is cancelled ?

No.
The action was blocked, so has been attempted per the restrictions of
No Repeat Actions, and may not be taken again that turn by Krassimir.

Section 3.19 of the FAQ, here:
http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_faq.htm

Section 6.4.1 of the tournament rules, here:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknRules.html

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
